question: Where is gallery situated within 80 kilometers along the corridor from South 6th St. Community Garden, Philadelphia, PA to Demuth Museum, Lancaster, PA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%South 6th St. Community Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Philadelphia%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Demuth Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lancaster%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 80000 ) );
